title: senecio scaberulus
intro: Senecio scaberulus, commonly known as Prickly Groundsel, is a flowering plant in the family Asteraceae. It is known for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may aid in reducing inflammation and protecting against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Senecio scaberulus include its ability to modulate the immune system and exhibit antimicrobial activity. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones and phenolic compounds, such as flavonoids and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
